relation_types.label: Mentions
relation_types.description: Document text references an ontology entity

relation_types.label: Alias of
relation_types.description: Entity is an alternative name or spelling of another entity

relation_types.label: Described in
relation_types.description: Concept, event, or instrument is described in an authoritative text

relation_types.label: Authored by
relation_types.description: Astronomical treatise was composed by astronomer/author

relation_types.label: Located in Vīthī
relation_types.description: Nakshatra belongs to a specific celestial lane (Vīthī)

relation_types.label: Subdivision of Mārga
relation_types.description: Vīthī is a subdivision of a major celestial highway (Mārga)

relation_types.label: Spans across Rāśi
relation_types.description: Nakshatra segment falls within a zodiac sign

relation_types.label: Ruled by planet
relation_types.description: Zodiac sign is ruled by planetary lord (Graha)

relation_types.label: Associated season
relation_types.description: Season (Ṛtu) corresponds to solar transit in zodiac sign

relation_types.label: Composed at
relation_types.description: Astronomical treatise was written or formulated at location

relation_types.label: Active at place
relation_types.description: A person or instrument is associated with a geographic place

relation_types.label: Used to measure
relation_types.description: Instrument is used to measure or compute astronomical concept

relation_types.label: Relates to astronomical event
relation_types.description: Mathematical concept or parallax factor relates to astronomical event

sources.description: 28 Nakshatra metadata: devatas, margas, veethis, asterism shapes, star counts (Vedāṅga Jyotiṣa), and yogatārā identifications
Vedic devatas and alternate Taittirīya Saṃhitā (TS 4.4.10) nakshatra names and notes
Stellarium definitions for nakshatras, rashis (zodiac signs), and yogatara anchors
Classification of the 3 Mārgas and 9 Vīthīs
Ṛtus (seasons), special anchor stars (Agastya, Dhruva), and cosmographic asterisms (Śiṃśumāra, Matsya)
Vedāṅga Jyotiṣa time and calendrical units
Corpus of 120 Indian Journal of History of Science (IJHS) research papers on Indian astronomy, mathematics, and instruments
Surya Siddhanta time and yuga cycle ratios used by the enrichment pass
